facts: Service dogs are trained to know when they are on duty. When their harness is on, they know it's business time. When you take it off, the pups immediately become playful and energetic.
Big happy "helicopter" tail wagging is one sign of a really nice dog
A dog's whiskers are used as sensing devices.
Dogs evolved from an extinct wolf-like creature in Eurasia 40,000 years ago.
A dog's sense of smell is so powerful that they can detect a drop of blood in a large swimming pool.
